sources.title: Skywork-Reward-V2-Qwen3-0.6B · Models
sources.snippet: Available in eight models across multiple sizes, with the smallest 0.6B variant, Skywork-Reward-V2-Qwen3-.6B, nearly matching the average performance of our previous best model, Skywork-Reward-Gemma-2-27B-v0.2. The largest 8B version, Skywork-Reward-V2-Llama-3.1-8B, surpasses all existing reward models across all benchmarks on average.
